add_model_to_collection: add a model to a Hugging Face collection given the collection slug and model ID
authenticate_hf_api: authenticate with Hugging Face API using the HF_TOKEN environment variable
verify_model_exists: verify a model exists on Hugging Face before adding it to a collection
add_collection_item: add a model item with an optional note to an existing Hugging Face collection
run_cli_add_model: run the CLI to add a model to a Hugging Face collection via --collection and --model arguments
